fact: 1944年6月6日，西方盟军发动代号“霸王行动”（Operation Overlord）的跨海峡登陆，开辟欧洲第二战场；艾森豪威尔任最高统帅，行动最终涉及12个国家协同，当天入夜约16万盟军登上诺曼底滩头。

sources.title: D-Day: The Allies Invade Europe | The National WWII Museum
sources.quote: General Dwight D. Eisenhower was supreme commander of the operation that ultimately involved the coordinated efforts of 12 nations. ... By nightfall, about 160,000 Allied troops were ashore with nearly a million more men on the way that summer.

sources.title: FACT SHEET: Normandy Landings | The White House (Obama Administration archive)
sources.quote: Over the following days the Allies gradually expanded their tenuous foothold.

fact: 奥马哈海滩是当天最惨烈的登陆点；约3.4万名美军当天上岸，伤亡（阵亡、负伤或失踪）超过2400人，损失率超过7%。

sources.title: D-Day: The Allies Invade Europe | The National WWII Museum
sources.quote: By midday, the Americans had surmounted the cliffs and taken Omaha Beach at a heavy cost: over 2,400 killed, wounded, or missing out of the total of approximately 34,000 who came ashore that day, a loss rate of more than 7 percent.

fact: 6月6日当天盟军伤亡估计约1万人（阵亡、负伤、失踪），其中美军6603人、英军2700人、加军946人。

sources.title: FACT SHEET: Normandy Landings | The White House (Obama Administration archive)
sources.quote: Allied casualties on June 6 have been estimated at 10,000 killed, wounded, and missing in action: 6,603 Americans, 2,700 British, and 946 Canadians.

sources.title: D-Day Fact Sheet | The National WWII Museum
sources.quote: The Allies suffered over 10,300 total casualties (killed, wounded, or missing), of which approximately 2,400 were on Omaha Beach.

fact: 1944年8月25日，勒克莱尔将军率法军第2装甲师进入巴黎，德军城防司令肖尔蒂茨（Dietrich von Choltitz）被俘，在巴黎警察总部与勒克莱尔、内地军（FFI）领袖罗尔- Tangui 共同签署德军投降书，巴黎解放。

sources.title: Le 25 aout 1944, Paris libéré | Ministère des Armées (法国国防部)
sources.quote: le 25 août au matin la 2e DB et les troupes alliées investissent Paris. Le général Leclerc installe son poste de commandement à la gare Montparnasse. Von Choltitz est capturé vers 15h et signe la capitulation à la préfecture de police.

sources.title: Paris | L'Ordre de la Libération et son Musée
sources.quote: Von Choltitz surrendered, before being driven to the police headquarters where he signed, together with Leclerc and Rol-Tanguy, the surrender agreement of German troops.

fact: 解放初期对通敌者的清算（épuration）中，学术研究估计真正的处决数字约为3700至4500人，其中约四分之三为法外就地处决、四分之一经法律程序；此前流传的1万至1.05万处决数字被认为高估。

sources.title: The Liberation: myths and history (Trinity College Dublin, History Department)
sources.quote: Between 3,700 and 4,500 is the true figure of executions at the Libération, about 3/4 of them summary and 1/4 after due process.

fact: 解放后配给卡制度并未取消，每张配给卡每月只供应几克糖、每周几克肉，婴儿死亡率在部分地区超过千分之一百；配给卡一直存续到1949年才废除。配给与 rationing 是当时法国普通人取得基本食物的合法身份凭证。

sources.title: 1945 - La reconstruction et les ordonnances de 1945 | Assemblée nationale (法国国民议会)
sources.quote: chaque Français n'a droit qu'à quelques grammes de sucre par mois ou de viande par semaine ; la mortalité infantile dépasse cent pour mille dans certaines régions. Les cartes de rationnement perdurent jusqu'à leur disparition en 1949.

fact: 解放后巴黎黑市价格远高于官价：1公斤面包官价定为3.75法郎，但“大衣底下”的黑市实际要付20至30法郎，约为官价的5至8倍。

sources.title: Kriegsende in Frankreich | Bundeszentrale für politische Bildung (德国联邦政治教育中心)
sources.quote: Auch wenn der Preis für ein Kilo Brot in Paris offiziell auf 3,75 Francs festgelegt war, mussten "unter dem Mantel" zwischen 20 und 30 Francs bezahlt.

fact: 解放后约半年，一名巴黎成年人凭正规配给每天约12.5盎司面包、9盎司土豆，每周约2.5盎司脂肪、7盎司肉；这一数量远低于正常热量需求，黑市补差价成为生存必需。

sources.title: Europe: From freedom to want | Fortune, 1945-05-01
sources.quote: Six months after liberation a Parisian adult was to live on the following quantities of food: 12.5 ounces of bread and 9 ounces of potatoes daily; 2.5 ounces of fat (or butter or lard) and 7 ounces of meat products per week.

fact: 1944年秋解放后法国出现剧烈通胀并延续数年：批发物价在1938至1944年间上涨约2.5倍，到1945年已上涨约3.5倍；零售物价随之上涨，法币购买力大幅缩水。

sources.title: 5. 1945-1960 « Révolutions » paysannes | Cairn.info
sources.quote: dès l'automne 1944 une inflation spectaculaire s'installe en France... Les prix de gros, multipliés par 2,5 entre 1938 et 1944, le sont par 3,5 en 1945.

fact: 随恢复推进，官定价格逐步向黑市价格靠拢，贸易重新回到合法市场；战前与占领期积累的黑市资产在通胀与价格并轨过程中被重估，持币者与持实物者处境分化。

sources.title: 'Economic Tyranny' and Public Anger in France, 1945-1947 | Contemporary European History (Cambridge Core)
sources.quote: Inflation eroded purchasing power and increased workers' demands for higher wages. As recovery advanced, inflation also stimulated new production, and as official prices converged towards those of the black market, traffic came back to legal markets.

fact: 德军在登陆前数月构筑“大西洋壁垒”，全长约2400英里，布设650万枚地雷、数千座混凝土碉堡与炮位，构成当时规模最大的海岸防御工程；盟军在登陆前以美英空军轰炸法北铁路桥与公路，切断德军预备队调动。

sources.title: D-Day: The Allies Invade Europe | The National WWII Museum
sources.quote: the enemy had spent months constructing the Atlantic Wall, a 2,400-mile line of obstacles. This defensive wall comprised 6.5 million mines, thousands of concrete bunkers and pillboxes containing heavy and fast-firing artillery.
